ModMetaData.name: Replace Stuff - Performance Edition [BETA]
ModMetaData.author: Kyle Givler
ModMetaData.description:
Performance-focused fork of the original "Replace Stuff" mod.
The goal is the same as the base mod: upgrade buildings in place without the usual deconstruct, wait, and rebuild loop. This fork reorganizes the internals around a clearer replacement pipeline, broader compatibility handling, and cleaner state restoration.
FEATURES: - Replace walls, workbenches, storage, and other supported buildings in place. - Preserve temperature settings, bills, storage settings, and other persistent building state where applicable. - Handle wall attachments, over-wall coolers and vents, rock, fog, and bridge-adjacent placement cases more gracefully. - Use registry-based compatibility handlers and legacy bridges for mod integrations.
STATUS: - This mod is still under active development and should be treated as alpha/early beta quality. - Please back up saves and report bugs with logs and reproduction steps.
SOURCE CODE/BUG REPORTS: - Source Code: https://github.com/JoyfulReaper/RimWorld-ReplaceStuff
CREDITS: - Original mod by Uuugggg / Alex Tearse-Doyle. - Fork and performance edition work by Kyle Givler. - Earlier optimization and compatibility ideas contributed by Hexnet111 and other community members.
